Data:Catalogue.book.baronial.json.label: Catalogue a Baronial Period book
Data:Catalogue.book.baronial.json.startdescription: This book was probably written around the time of Hush House's Baronial Period - roughly 1500s to 1700s. If I examine it, I can learn more about what knowledge it might contain. [Books from this period are only rarely contaminated.]

Data:Catalogue.journal.archaeologist.jso.label: A Journal?
Data:Catalogue.journal.archaeologist.jso.startdescription: My journal? That battered leather cover is familiar - but the storm so scattered my thoughts...
Data:Catalogue.journal.archaeologist.jso.desc: My journal - I'm sure of it. The storm scattered my thoughts, but each page I turn is familiar. I begin to recall now why I came here... to understand my curse, and redeem myself.  [More about your origin, and your aspirations, in your journal. You can now also access the Tree of Wisdoms from the top of the screen.]

Data:Catwink.json.Label: Catwink
Data:Catwink.json.Desc: The smell of catwink puts off vermin; but it is very difficult to read in sunlight. An Ink of Containment.

xexts.scrutiny: On close exposure, the smell tends to put off humans, too. [There are Prentice-level Moon recipes that can craft this.]

Data:Ch.order.send.json.label: Post a Completed Cater & Hero Order Form
Data:Ch.order.send.json.desc: The Postmistress signs and seals the order, and places it in the place that stamped orders are properly placed. 'Wait three days,' she commands.
